title: Low-Temperature Order in Quantum Heisenberg Ferromagnets
exact_target: For the short-range quantum Heisenberg ferromagnet in dimension $d\geq 3$, prove that sufficiently low temperature produces long-range order; specifically, prove that $\lim_{\Lambda\nearrow\mathbb{Z}^d}|\Lambda|^{-2}\sum_{x,y\in\Lambda}\langle\widetilde S_x\cdot\widetilde S_y\rangle_{T,\Lambda}>0$ for all sufficiently small $T>0$.
